objectives: Explain why the oath sworn to Abraham was performed unto Isaac.
Describe Isaac's prosperity and the envy of the Philistines.
Explain how Isaac dealt with those who hated him.
takeaways: The oath stood because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
The seed is Christ (Galatians 3:16); through Him scattered Israel in every nation receives repentance.
Love your wife, play with your wife, and keep the freshness in the marriage.
The nations envy the prosperity of Israel; the blessing itself is what is hated.
Isaac separated from those who hated him instead of assimilating among them: wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me?
